rows.text: The key to piloting Hope Estheim is understanding its core engine: Hope Estheim gains life through Soul Sisters and defensive enchantments, translating every point of life gained into mill against all opponents at end step. Pillowfort pieces protect your life total while Aetherflux Reservoir provides an alternate burst finisher.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe, Cyclonic Rift. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
